definitions.full: H6244. ashesh [ עָשֵׁשׁ ] verb waste away (compare Assyrian ašašu , moth ; Arabic moth (-worm), eat (of moth; ? denominative); according to De Psa 6:8 and others עָשֵׁשׁ is denominative from עָשׁ , properly be moth-eaten , but improbable); **according to Jacob ZMG 1901, 141; ZAW 1902, 107 be dark , compare עשׁשׁא darkness , in Christian-Palestinian Aramaic. — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular עֵינִי מִכַּעַם עָֽשְׁשָׁה Psa 6:8 my eye is wasted from grief , = 31:10 ( בְּכַעַס ; + בִּטְנִי נַפְשִׁי, ; 3 plural עָשֵׁ֫שׁוּ עֲצָמַי 31:11 .
